$comment: Generated by tools/ont-check/gen-contracts.mjs from the ontology. Do not edit by hand.

member.title: Member
member.description: A person registered with the library who can borrow.

borrowLimit.description: Maximum number of open loans for a member. Set by staff; default 5.

title.title: Title
title.description: A work in the catalog: a book, a board game, a tool model. Has one or more items.

item.title: Item
item.description: One physical copy of a title; the thing that is actually lent.

condition.description: Good, worn or damaged, recorded at return. A damaged item is not lent until repaired.

copyOf.description: The item is a physical copy of the title.

loan.title: Loan
loan.description: An item lent to a member, from checkout until return.

dueDate.description: When the item must be back: checkout plus the loan period, moved by renewals.

renewals.description: How many times the loan was renewed. A fact the system counts.

member.description: The member who borrowed the item.

hold.title: Hold
hold.description: A member's place in the queue for a title whose items are all out.

waitsFor.description: The hold is a place in this title's queue.

member.description: The member waiting in the queue.
